attempts.item: OD055 â€” multiple default PaymentMethods possible
attempts.reason: Manifest platform limitation: fanOut reactions run AFTER all mutations in a command and don't support != in where clauses. Attempted pattern: emit PaymentMethodDefaultSet â†’ fanOut PaymentMethod where clientId = X run clearDefault. This clears ALL matching rows including the one being set as default, because: (1) mutate isDefault = true happens first, (2) emit triggers fanOut, (3) fanOut clears ALL rows (no != support), (4) no way to restore the target row after fanOut. Constraints also cannot check across rows (only self.*). This feature requires Manifest platform changes: either != support in fanOut where clauses, cross-row constraints, or a different native exclusivity mechanism. Worktree preserved at .loop-worktrees/prod-20260721T1800-OD055-payment-method-default. 1/3 failures - not escalated yet.
